en.title: Cody Rhodes Welcomed Daughter Mid-Filming for Street Fighter Movie
en.summary: While shooting the upcoming live-action adaptation of the iconic fighting game, the WWE superstar received life-changing news in a rather unexpected setting. Rhodes shares the emotional story of how he learned of his second daughter's arrival.
en.body:
The world of blockbuster filmmaking often demands immense dedication, and the cast of the upcoming **Street Fighter** movie is no exception. For **Cody Rhodes**, who is set to embody the iconic Guile in the action-comedy adaptation, the production schedule presented a profound personal sacrifice. While immersed in the demanding process of bringing the beloved fighting game franchise to the big screen, Rhodes experienced one of life's most significant moments: the birth of his second daughter.

Rhodes revealed that he was on set, likely in the midst of filming a demanding scene, when he received word of his daughter Leilani Ella Runnels's arrival. The exact circumstances of how he learned the news during filming remain a poignant detail, highlighting the unique challenges and unexpected interruptions that can occur during a major production. Despite the emotional weight of the moment, Rhodes reportedly continued with his work, demonstrating a remarkable commitment to the film.

> "I remember thinking, 'This movie better be pretty good,' " he says, "because I missed a big one."

This deeply personal event underscores the sacrifices made not only by the actors but also by their families. While the film aims to capture the high-octane energy of **Street Fighter**, these behind-the-scenes stories remind us of the human element at the heart of every production. The birth of Leilani Ella Runnels on August 29, 2025, while Rhodes was actively filming, adds a unique layer of narrative to the making of the movie, a story that fans of both **Street Fighter** and **Cody Rhodes** will surely find compelling.

## A Fighter's Family Moment

For fans of **Cody Rhodes**, this news offers a powerful connection to their favorite wrestler-turned-actor. It humanizes the larger-than-life persona and provides context for the dedication he brings to his roles. The **Street Fighter** movie is already generating significant buzz, and knowing that such a monumental personal event occurred during its production only adds to the anticipation. It’s a testament to the passion and commitment involved in bringing these cherished characters and worlds to life, blending the intensity of a fighting game with the emotional realities of family life.

## What's Next for Guile and the Franchise

With filming now complete, anticipation is building for the **Street Fighter** movie's release. While specific details regarding the full release schedule have not yet been announced, **Cody Rhodes**'s involvement as Guile is a major draw for audiences. Fans can look forward to seeing how this blend of martial arts action and comedic storytelling brings the iconic game franchise to the silver screen.
